egypt.initial:
Use case: illustration-story. Production game banner DESIGN SOURCE, not installed hall overlay. Make one perfectly FLAT front-facing vertical rectangular cloth DESIGN, about1:3 aspect, aim600x1800 pixels, filling almost entire image with only tiny even plain MAGENTA #FF00FF margin. Absolutely NO cloth folds, waves, perspective, gradients, texture, shadows, glows, highlights, lighting, hanging rods, hardware, tassels, hall, people, lettering or numbers. This is a flat painted textile pattern sheet that will be warped later onto existing cloth, whose folds and lighting are already in the game. Perfect straight edges. Flat solid main colour field with emblem centred at one-third canvas height (upper third). Simple restrained clean2D anime cel-design linework in dark brown-purple, narrow border motif, emblem clear when downsampled to70px wide. Flat colours only, no photographic/3D fabric rendering. One source reused for left and right.
Egypt: solid lapis blue #1C4E80 field, gold #C8962E decoration. A stylised winged sun disc, horizontally spread balanced wings attached to gold sun disc, centred upper third. Restrained narrow lotus/papyrus geometric border bands, no hieroglyphs. No extra long hanging ornament.
egypt.flat_colour_correction:
Edit only the indicated nation design among the three recent tall banner images. Retain its layout, emblem, border motifs, straight rectangular contour, upper-third emblem placement and 1:3 shape. CRITICAL correction: replace every main-field pixel with ONE absolutely UNIFORM solid colour, NO gradient and NO noise/grain/texture. Replace all emblem and border fill regions by uniform flat spot colours, remove their highlights or gradients. Think a flat vector/SVG-style PRINT pattern exported as raster PNG: solid flood-fill areas, fine dark brown-purple outlines only, NOT fabric illustration. No rendered material, folds, lighting, shadow or glow. Remove incidental mottling even when subtle. Small pure MAGENTA#FF00FF outside margin; no words/numbers.
Egypt is the BLUE GOLD WINGED SUN banner. Field solid #1C4E80, all gold decoration solid #C8962E.
egypt.keyable_margin_correction:
Final production correction. Edit ONLY the named nation's existing flat banner design from recent images. Keep its artwork, emblem, colours and border motifs unchanged. Add an EVEN, UNBROKEN solid pureMAGENTA #FF00FF background frame ALL FOUR SIDES, at least40px wide at this image scale. The printed rectangle must now fit entirely INSIDE that magenta frame; inset its top,left,right,bottom edges so every outer corner and a40x40px square at each corner is nothing but magenta. NOT a magenta line inside the decoration; this is the OUTSIDE removable backdrop around the whole artwork. Retain portrait aspect3:1 and flat flood-fill design, no folds/lighting/shadows/text. Reposition via the image edit itself, do not zoom or crop away border. The background keyer samples corners, so sufficiently wide plain magenta margins are critical. The banner's motif remains at upper third of printed rectangle.
Egypt: the lapis blue and gold winged-sun disc, lotus/papyrus side bands.
